methodology.scope: Original GDN AKA reproduction snapshot, not current Runtime GDN/GDN-full campaigns
methodology.latency: Baseline memory/v0.json, then verification.candidate_latency_us only on accepted=true; otherwise carry last retained value, not a new measurement
methodology.tokens: telemetry.summary.json phase_tokens.terminal_usage; total=input+output, caches already included in input; exact/partial/unavailable preserved; cumulative_known_tokens ignores unknown amounts without treating them as zero-cost
methodology.time: Approximation: preserved episode BRIEF.md mtime through outcome/promotion Git committer time; attempt.json mtime cross-checked to within one second; includes Gateway wait, validation and in-episode recovery; excludes gaps between episodes and pre-EP1 bootstrap
methodology.currency: Token counts are usage evidence, not provider billing verification
